Author:     Airat Makhmutov <rauty@altlinux.org>

CommitDate: Fri May 29 12:44:53 2026 +0300

    Bug 2041292 - Size the standalone OpenPGP key wizard window with sizeToContent(). r=Paenglab,mkmelin
    
    
    resizeWindow() sized the standalone "Generate OpenPGP Key" wizard window
    with window.resizeTo(), using the visible section's clientHeight plus an
    arbitrary 100px guess for the dialog buttons that live in the <dialog>
    shadow DOM.
    
    While the window is still being mapped the outerHeight/innerHeight values
    are not settled, so the computed height falls short and the "Cancel" and
    "Generate key" buttons are clipped off the bottom of the window on
    GNOME/Wayland until the user resizes it by hand.
    
    Use window.sizeToContent() instead, letting Gecko measure the content and
    account for the shadow-DOM dialog buttons and the window decorations
    consistently across compositors.
    
    This is a regression from the fix for bug 1922934, which replaced the
    earlier body.scrollHeight based computation with the clientHeight + 100
    heuristic.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D302023

diff --git a/mail/extensions/openpgp/content/ui/keyWizard.js b/mail/extensions/openpgp/content/ui/keyWizard.js
index f3d91e6795f..ffe53f7f4a9 100644
--- a/mail/extensions/openpgp/content/ui/keyWizard.js
+++ b/mail/extensions/openpgp/content/ui/keyWizard.js
@@ -588,12 +588,7 @@ function resizeWindow() {
     return;
   }
 
-  // Add an arbitrary 100px height to account for the dialog buttons in the
-  // shadow DOM.
-  window.resizeTo(
-    window.outerWidth,
-    document.querySelector(`.wizard-section:not([hidden])`).clientHeight + 100
-  );
+  window.sizeToContent();
 }
